title: Vercel case study
description: A customer story on a 12-column grid: a big tight heading above a wide 8-column screenshot window, with a narrow 3-column text column beside it holding a two-tone statement (the claim in ink, the rest in grey) and a short list of feature links under a small grey label. The window can stand alone or sit in front of a second window peeking out behind-left; both fade into the page at the bottom. Mirror it with align to alternate stories.
notes: align start puts the window left and the text right; end mirrors it (heading moves over the window)
phones always stack heading, window(s), statement, features
media slots: front window (and an optional back window); empty, they are ringed grey windows
no motion of its own (the original's motion is inside its screenshots)
name: vercel-case

props.name: title
props.description: the big heading over the window

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: width of the heading, which sets where it breaks (a Tailwind max-w class)

props.name: lead
props.description: the statement's first words, in ink (e.g. "Pagewright handles millions")

props.name: rest
props.description: the rest of the statement, in grey

props.name: featuresLabel
props.description: small grey label over the feature list

props.name: align
props.description: start: window left, text right · end: text left, window right

props.name: media
props.description: the front window's content (screenshot, video); a grey window when empty

props.name: backMedia
props.description: a second window behind-left of the front one; a grey window when empty and layered

props.name: layered
props.description: always: two windows on every width · phone: two on phones, one wide window on desktop · none: one window

props.name: mediaLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the window placeholders
